notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS product (search/product discovery) evaluating Redwood to replace an internal embedding pipeline and to reduce infra ops. Wants fast path to production via hosted API, then deterministic cost for enterprise customers via Dedicated.

Key quotes: "Need <50ms median vector lookups at 200 qps for top-10 rerank path"; "Can we push bulk embed jobs overnight — cost needs to be <50% current infra".

Security/Compliance: SOC2 necessary, SSO/SAML for admin console, KMS for key separation. Data residency: US primary but some EU tenant data to be isolated via VPC in eu-west.

Commercial: Prefers annual committed pricing if Dedicated capacity yields predictable unit economics. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization) to lower token cost.

Staging plan: start hosted POC with subset (1M docs) -> evaluate embedding similarity recall + latency -> ramp to 20M docs on Dedicated trial if pass.

Notes snippets: "need JDBC-style connector to their Postgres + Pinecone currently for fast joins"; "they'll run ~6-8 batch embedding jobs/month (each ~200k documents)".
requirements_summary: Primary: embeddings for semantic search + reranking. Must support bulk embed jobs and on-the-fly single-record embeddings for product pages. Throughput target: sustained 200 QPS (search path) with <80ms 95th for embedding call + retrieval pipeline. Need vector DB integration guidance + direct connector or recommended pattern for Postgres + vector DB hybrid queries.
throughput_targets: search path: sustained 200 QPS; batch jobs: 200k docs per job, 6-8 jobs/month; target embed throughput for batch: ~10k docs/min (parallelized) or better
vector_db_integration_notes: Customer currently uses Pinecone + custom similarity service. Wants either: (a) keep Pinecone + use Redwood hosted embeddings, or (b) move to Dedicated + colocated vector index for lower lookup latency. Concern: cross-region vector lookups for EU tenants. Ask: sample patterns for hybrid Postgres + vector DB joins; recommended index sharding for multi-tenant data.
poc_plan: Phase 0: quick smoke on hosted API (1 day) with sample 10k docs. Phase 1 (2 weeks): hosted POC - run recall tests, latency bench, and 2 batch embed jobs. Phase 2 (3 weeks): Dedicated trial for 1 shard with routing policy, compare 95th latency and cost. Success criteria: recall within 5% of baseline, 95th latency <80ms for embed+lookup, batch embed cost <= 50% of current infra.
pricing_expectation: Looking for hosted rates for bulk embeddings and committed Dedicated capacity quote. Internal target ARR math: want per-embed cost reduced by ~30% vs current setup. Will trade committed term (12-24mo) for lower unit price. Needs example TCO model for 100k qpm-month to present to finance.
